Watts made this hymn from Psalm 133, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony! 2It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes. 3It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore. PSALM 133 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 133
